subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps from today's demo - Acme Commerce
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan@acmecommerce.com>, Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps from today's demo - Acme Commerce

Hi Jordan / Elaine —

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard:
- Primary use case: product search personalization across web + mobile (session-level recs + long-term embeddings).
- Latency SLO: p95 < 120ms for search re-rank.
- Volume: ~1200 QPS peak across clusters, spiking during promotions.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Stakeholder mapping: could you share a simple org chart or list of decision-makers for procurement, security, and the economic buyer (finance)? That will help us tailor the SOW and procurement timeline.
2) Security/compliance: if you have a standard security questionnaire (or a point person), please share — we can run our SOC 2 + architecture notes by them.
3) Procurement timeline: any internal milestones we should know (vendor review, legal redlines, PO/contract sign date)?

I've attached a draft SOW (RDW-SOW-draft.docx) and a template org-chart request. As discussed, Marissa (our AE) will help with stakeholder intros and procurement coordination.

Proposed next meeting: 1-hour procurement + security sync next Wed (21 Jul) — does 10am PT work for your team?

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | (415) 555-0143

Attachments: RDW-SOW-draft.docx

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & next steps from today's demo - Acme Commerce

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap and the SOW. Quick answers from our side: 

- I'll be the internal champion, but the economic buyer is likely Liam O'Connor (CFO). Looping him in once we have a rough commercial outline.
- Security will be handled by Priya Singh (Head of InfoSec) — copied above. She'll want our standard questionnaire filled out; can you send a link or PDF?
- Procurement timeline: we have a vendor review on Aug 3, legal prefers 2 weeks for redlines, and we aim to have a PO by Aug 17 if all goes smoothly.

Also attaching a high-level org chart I sketched — it's rough but shows who needs to be involved. Please add any missing roles.

On timing: 21 Jul at 10am PT works for me. Priya is usually only available mornings, so if Marissa can own adjusting times that'd be great.

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Product | Acme Commerce
jordan@acmecommerce.com

Jordan / team —

Nice to meet you over the demo today — looping in Alex (Solutions) for any technical/security artifacts. I attached an updated org chart (Acme_org_chart_v2.pdf) with the contacts I pulled from LinkedIn and your notes:

- Economic buyer: Liam O'Connor, CFO — primary sign-off for >$250k ARR deals.
- Procurement: Elaine Wu — handles PO and vendor intake.
- Legal: Michael Reed, Sr. Counsel (typically reviews T&Cs).
- Security/InfoSec: Priya Singh — will own the questionnaire.
- Platform/Infra stakeholder: Aaron Patel (VP Eng) — will validate latency & deployment constraints.

Alex — per Priya, I'll send the SOC 2 + architecture diagram and a short security summary that addresses data residency and audit log retention. Alex, can you also provide a short note on quantization/latency tradeoffs we can include for Priya?

Jordan — based on the procurement timeline you shared, target milestones could be:
- Jul 21: Procurement/Security sync (alignment + confirm questionnaire scope)
- Jul 28: SOW + commercial draft to your procurement/legal
- Aug 3: Vendor review (internal)
- Aug 17: Target PO/contract execution

If those look reasonable, I'll lock the 21 Jul 10am PT meeting and pull the Priya/Michael/Liam invites.

Best,
